subject: ela
intro: Pick the connection between the ideas.

items.prompt:
Read.

The ground was dry, so the farmer watered the crops.

The connection is:
A) cause and effect
B) sequence
C) comparison

Read.

First mix, next add eggs, then bake.

The connection is:
A) comparison
B) sequence
C) cause and effect

Read.

Frogs and toads look alike, but toads are bumpier.

The connection is:
A) comparison
B) sequence
C) cause and effect

Which signal word shows CAUSE and effect?
A) because
B) first
C) like

Read.

It rained all night, so the river rose.

What caused the river to rise?
A) The rain
B) The river
C) The night

steps: Rain is the cause. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which words signal a SEQUENCE?
A) first, next, then
B) because, so
C) like, but

Read.

Bees and butterflies both drink nectar, but only bees make honey.

This text mainly shows:
A) a comparison of bees and butterflies
B) steps in order
C) one cause and one effect
items.answer: A) a comparison of bees and butterflies

solution.answer: A) a comparison of bees and butterflies

items.prompt:
Read.

The batteries died, so the flashlight stopped working.

The EFFECT is:
A) the batteries died
B) the flashlight stopped working
C) there is no effect

steps: Effect is the result. Key is B.
